messages:
Alex G: Kicking off CHI1 prep — we need a quick rollup of owners and the tiny PRs that unblock routing + residency. Targeting a canary next Wed. Can owners confirm what they can take and any blockers?
Maya R: I can own proxy routing and ingress ACLs. Will open a PR to update route-policy and nginx conf by EOD.
Sam P: I’ll own DB replica + residency verification. Question: do we want cross-region read replicas for initial launch or just a standby replica?
Julie: Security owns KMS/keys + secrets gating. We need a compliance ticket for customer-keying. @Leo can you raise the ticket with the SRE checklist?
Leo: Yep, filing now. Also flag: is customer peering PrivateLink or VPC peering for CHI1? Prefers PrivateLink but need cost + infra signoff.
Alex G: Preference noted. Milestones (high-level):
  1) route-policy + proxy PR merged
  2) KMS ticket approved and key provisioned
  3) DB replica promoted/standby live and residency checks green
  4) canary traffic shift + rollback playbook confirmed
Target = next Wed for canary. Anyone blocked on infra or bake?
Sam P: Blocked on AMI bake for the new runtime image — last bake for CHI1 was 1749000000. @deploy-bot can you re-run canonical bake for chi1?
deploy-bot: Bake request queued: job#4823 for image-redwood-runtime-chi1. Estimated runtime ~2h. I will post results here.
ops-bot: NOTE: remember to update the regional SLO doc and oncall rotation if we push canary into working hours.
Julie: I left a comment on PR #4021 about secrets scanning — small change (remove hardcoded env) before merge.
Maya R: Route policy snippet I’ll push (preview):
```json
{
  "region": "chi1",
  "egress_policy": "regional-first",
  "preferred_edge": ["chi1-edge-01", "chi1-edge-02"],
  "fallback": "usw2",
  "data_residency": {"db": "chi1", "logs": "usw2-encrypt"}
}
```
Alex G: Good. Sam, once AMI bake posts success can you kick off the replica build script (`infra/scripts/replica-provision.sh`) and paste the run id here?
Sam P: Will do. If replica provisioning hits the subnet quota, I’ll ping infra owners.
Leo: KMS ticket submitted: TKT-1287, included security checklist and required audit keys. Linking the ticket: https://internal.ticket/TKT-1287
Maya R: PRs I’ll open: route-policy update + nginx routing change + smoke test tweak. Tagging @Alex G for quick review when ready.
Alex G: I’ll do the reviews in the afternoon. Also: can someone own rollback playbook notes? Small checklist: endpoint cut, traffic drain, KV cache flush, and fallback model mapping.
Julie: Security will add the KV cache flush steps to the playbook and verify audit logging.
Sam P: Replica provision run id: rep-chi1-2026-07-21-77 (started after bake). Posting logs if anything fails.
Maya R: PR links: https://git.internal/r/redwood/route-policy/pulls/189, https://git.internal/r/redwood/proxy/pulls/294 
Alex G: Great. If no blockers by EOD we’ll mark milestone 1 in the project board and schedule a dry-run traffic shift in staging tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Leo: FYI cost team asked for rough estimate on PrivateLink vs peering, I’ll email numbers today.
Sam P: Quick ask — can infra increase ephemeral IP quota in chi1 by +50 for canary? If yes, @ops-bot can you open an infra request?
ops-bot: Infra request opened: INFRA-5503 (ephemeral IP quota). Owner: infra-ops. ETA 24-48h.
Alex G: Thanks all. I’ll follow up with a short checklist in the project board and ping again after PR merges. Remember to @mention owner when you post PRs.
